semiconductor_relevance: High — Maruichi Stainless Tube manufactures high-quality seamless stainless steel pipes specifically for gas and chemical piping in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Maruichi Stainless Steel Tube, formerly Kobelco Steel Tube, specializes in the production of seamless stainless steel pipes, which are essential for gas and chemical delivery systems in semiconductor manufacturing. The company collaborates with Valex to ensure the cleanliness and quality of its products, making them suitable for critical applications in the semiconductor sector.
capabilities: Seamless stainless steel pipes for gas and chemical piping
Collaboration with Valex for electrolytic polishing
